title: Self-contained check in CI
goal: A skill that links what it does not bundle fails CI
acceptance: A check fails on links or paths outside the skill folder (AGENTS.md, BACKLOG-RULES, tools/, docs/) and on .harness.json requirements; an allowlist covers the repository URL
It runs in CI next to check:template; a test covers pass and fail cases
privacy: Skill and tool text only; examples invented; no personal data.
escalation: A skill that cannot stand alone without restating a harness rule goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: a link scan over skills/**.
